planets.name: Kepler-94 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-94 with a 2.51-day year, found in 2014.

text.card: Kepler-94 b was found in 2014 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around Kepler-94. Its orbit and size follow Marcy et al. 2014's fit, the archive's default.
